learning_outcomes.text: explain fundamental concepts of computer vision such as object recognition, measurement, and motion detection
understand Deep Learning and its application to visual data
know standard implementations of methods in computer vision and be able to apply them
develop solutions to problems in computer vision
apply scientific working methods in independently recognizing, formulating, and solving problems

syllabus_topics: Challenge of machine vision (Computer Vision) and basics
Generative image models and representation learning
Challenges in using machine learning methods for Computer Vision

assessment_methods.method: Oral presentation of solutions for at least two exercise assignments

assessment_rules: To acquire credit points, students must achieve at least 50 percent of the points from the weekly exercise assignments and orally present the solution to at least two of the exercise assignments. The examination performance can be either an oral examination or a written examination (Klausur). Grading is based on a scale of 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the M.Sc. Computer Science degree program.
bibliography: Torralba, Antonio, Phillip Isola, & William T. Freeman (2024). Foundations of Computer Vision. MIT Press.
Szeliski, Richard (2022). Computer Vision: Algorithms and Applications. Springer Nature.
Burger, Wilhelm & Burge, Mark. J. (2022). Digital Image Processing: An Algorithmic Introduction. Springer Nature.
